source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check Chassis information and detail information, then compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES queries an assumed /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_CEMR URI with insecure curl and projects three fields, omitting the right-slot proof and mandatory WebUI/IPMI comparison.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires right-module mapping and complete protected parity but retains an unnecessary human confirmation gate for read-only Project parameters.

old_problem: A mirrored CEML record can share manufacturer/product/part data with CEMR, so a plausible three-field response does not establish the right module. The historical record captured this risk but left ordinary right-slot, IPMI target and expected-content bindings as Engineering Decision Pending.
disposition_reason: Require a durable physical right-slot association before selecting the CEMR IPMI device and UI/API member, explicitly reject CEML/CEMBB identities, decode every applicable standard and vendor field, and reconcile complete raw/normalized evidence against the right-module manufacturing record. These are safe deterministic reads once the Project package is supplied.
decision_basis: XLSX row 954, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 955 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 955 / variant c4eff07c76e253c5.

CEMR's distinguishing requirement is physical right-side identity. Shared product/manufacturer/part fields cannot distinguish it from CEML, and IPMI device numbering or a resource suffix is not a standard side relationship.
IPMI FRU standard areas and DMTF Assembly fields support complete decoding and identity comparison; the Project/vendor topology remains authoritative for the right-slot binding.
Both source-required evidence planes remain mandatory: rendered BMC WebUI detail and complete `ipmitool fru print`; Redfish/OEM inventory is supplementary mapping/correlation evidence.

ED-02, ED-08, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 preserve distinct coverage and evidence, while ED-33 through ED-38 support parameterized read-only execution without guessed OEM behavior or cross-crediting the left module.

test_case.test_name: Validate right CEM module FRU with physical-side-bound cross-interface parity
test_case.purpose: Prove that the selected management records belong to the Project-defined physical right CEM module and verify its complete applicable FRU contents against the authoritative right-module record and actual WebUI, independently of the left module and CEM baseboard, without changing FRU/BMC/DUT state.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/chassis identity and approved CEM topology with durable physical associations for right, left and baseboard modules
Complete enumerated IPMI FRU map and approved CEMR device ID/interface/channel/bridge/address; device order must not encode side implicitly
Mapped Redfish Chassis/Assembly or approved OEM CEMR member relationships and the actual WebUI Inventory and LEDs right-module row/detail
CEMR-specific FRU area and required-field layout including Board/Product, applicable Chassis/MultiRecord and vendor custom fields or side/location extensions
Authoritative right-module BOM/manufacturing/asset data with serial or stable unique identifier, expected values and approved encoding/blank/padding/freshness rules
Certificate trust, protected read-only credential handling, protected evidence storage and redaction/tokenization policy
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Confirm the immutable chassis and approved CEM topology; enumerate every IPMI FRU through the approved protected interface/channel/bridge and preserve the full map. Select the CEMR device only from the durable physical right-slot association and a unique module identity, never from ID order or common product fields. Execute only `ipmitool ... fru print <CEMR-FRU-ID>` and retain complete output, return code and parser/checksum diagnostics. Follow actual Redfish links to the mapped Chassis/Assembly or approved OEM record, and capture the fully rendered WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs CEMR row/detail. Use CEML/CEMBB identities solely to demonstrate non-selection. Decode all applicable standard/custom FRU fields, preserve raw representations, apply only approved normalization and compare field by field with the right-module authority and across IPMI/UI/API. Repeat read fingerprints only; never perform FRU writes/edits, raw storage writes, inventory refresh, log clearing, reset, reboot or power operations.
test_case.expected_result: The physical right CEM module maps uniquely to the selected CEMR IPMI FRU device and approved UI/API member and cannot resolve to CEML or CEMBB. All applicable areas decode without reported structure/checksum errors; every required standard/custom field is present or has its approved absent representation and exactly agrees with the authoritative right-module data after traceable normalization. WebUI, IPMI and mapped Redfish/OEM evidence reconcile, with no unexpected duplicate/extra/stale record and no state mutation.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires right-slot physical proof, unique mapped device/member, complete `ipmitool fru print`, actual WebUI visual detail, successful complete-field decoding and exact reference parity. A CEMR label, first/next FRU ID, mirrored product tuple or three-field API match is insufficient. Left/baseboard selection, ambiguous/duplicate mapping, missing required area/field, parser/checksum failure, unauthorized blank or unexplained UI/IPMI/API/reference mismatch is FAIL. Missing topology/layout/reference is NOT READY rather than Pending; N/A requires authoritative SPEC evidence.
safety_gate: Use protected read-only IPMI and certificate-verified API/UI sessions; reject process-visible secrets and insecure-TLS acceptance evidence.
Bind the right physical slot through approved topology and durable relationships before reading the target record; never infer side from naming, enumeration order or common manufacturing values.
Limit IPMI to enumeration and `fru print`. Prohibit write/edit/upgEkey, raw storage writes, log clearing, BMC reset, reboot and power actions.
Keep CEML and CEMBB as negative identity controls only; their observations or expected values may not satisfy this independent case.
Preserve raw full records and actual rendered WebUI evidence before applying approved normalization or redaction; keep stable audit tokens and protected originals.
Stop on cross-side ambiguity, duplicate identity, stale cache, decode/checksum error or authority conflict and do not automatically try another device.
expected_evidence: Immutable target plus physical CEM topology identifying the right module and negative left/baseboard tokens
Complete enumerated IPMI FRU map and timestamped `fru print <CEMR-FRU-ID>` evidence with channel/bridge, exit code, decode/checksum status and protected hash
Discovered Redfish/OEM link chain and complete CEMR artifact with schema/firmware/certificate metadata
Actual rendered WebUI Inventory and LEDs CEMR row/detail visual evidence showing the right-module identity and required fields
CEMR area-aware raw/normalized/reference matrix for every required standard/custom field and explicit CEML/CEMBB exclusion
Pre/post fingerprints, uncleared SEL/audit evidence, no-write/no-reset/no-power proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On ambiguous right-slot binding, duplicate identifiers, decode/checksum failure or source disagreement, stop and preserve/redact all evidence; obtain the authoritative topology/layout/reference. Do not trial the left/baseboard FRU, rewrite inventory, clear logs, reset BMC, reboot or power-cycle, and do not automatically retry against a different module.

source_conflict.reason: The Master consistently identifies the right CEM FRU and requires WebUI/IPMI correctness. DeepSeek's partial path is an implementation gap, not a source contradiction.

blocked.reason: Right-module identity and parity semantics are clear. The topology, management map, field layout and expected record are bounded Project inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Physical CEM right/left/baseboard topology; CEMR IPMI device/channel/bridge; mapped API/UI identities; FRU area/custom-field layout; right-module manufacturing values; normalization, freshness and redaction.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ-ONLY FRU_CEMR REVIEW ONLY; NO IPMI, REDFISH, WEBUI OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
